commit_message: Kind Words: rotate 80-review WarmShowers pool on a 4-day cycle
change_scope: Homepage Kind Words section ONLY (verified: live base prefix and suffix byte-identical outside the section).
rotation: 12 verbatim WarmShowers host-review quotes in 4 sets of 3; setIndex = floor(daysSinceEpoch/4) mod 4, computed client-side from the visitor's date — same set for every visitor for 4 days, then advances; no cron or rebuilds. Set 1 is also the static no-JS fallback HTML.
quote_sources: All quotes verbatim excerpts of ~/workspace/your_files/warmshowers/reviews-archive.md (see build report for review numbers). The single 4/5 mixed review (#37) excluded.
required_markers: the bravest cyclist I have ever hosted
forbidden_markers: coordinate-like pattern /\b\d{1,3}\.\d{4,}\b/ (scan of finished file: none)
live_checks_after_publish: https://rideordieamerica.com/ returns 200 and contains '80 five-star host reviews on WarmShowers'
Homepage Kind Words section shows 3 .kw cards (set for the current 4-day window)
View-source contains all 12 quote strings (rotation pool embedded)
revert_note: Pre-change live index.html backed up at ~/workspace/tmp/kind-words-backup-oct31/index-live.html (captured from the live site 2026-10-31 before edits).
